resources.string: Optionally allow HabitFlow to read exercise sessions from Health Connect. Your existing habits work without it. Nothing is tracked in the background; you can preview exercise, apply a completion, or explicitly sync eligible mapped habits.

HabitFlow reads exercise only when you request a preview or a one-time sync. You can remove your mappings without losing completed habits.

This removes saved mappings and exercise source IDs from HabitFlow. Existing habit completions and the local undo history are kept. To revoke Android permission, also remove HabitFlow access in Health Connect settings.

One-time action: read today’s exercise sessions for your saved mappings and complete qualifying habits now. Manual completions and previously undone exercise completions are preserved. No background sync.

HabitFlow requests only exercise-session read access. It does not write health records or upload your health information. You can revoke access in Health Connect settings at any time.

If you opt in, HabitFlow can read exercise sessions from Health Connect to support future walking, running, and cycling habit mappings. Health records stay on your device; HabitFlow will not upload them or change them. It never needs health access for manual habits. You control and can revoke permissions in Health Connect settings.
Restart the app for the changes to take effect
